title: Offline downloads are here…
message:
Hey everyone…

Aniraku just got a small miracle. One kind user bought a monthly Patreon membership, and that single act is literally helping keep the lights on every month. I’m genuinely grateful — it means more than you know.

The latest update finally brings proper offline downloads (no external tools needed).

Want an anime added? Found a bug? Have a feature idea? Or just want to say something? Mail us at sho.islam0311@proton.me. I’m still waiting for more voices… it gets a bit quiet sometimes, and I keep checking my inbox like a protagonist waiting for that one important letter that never comes.

I’m also looking for a couple of kind souls to help build a proper Discord and Telegram community. I’m not exactly a natural community manager (more like the quiet guy who just wants everyone to watch anime in peace), so any help would mean a lot.

If you want Aniraku to stay available and keep improving, please consider donating. Every contribution keeps the episodes playing and this little passion project alive.

Thank you for still being here.

— the guy who still hasn’t slept enough
